races.paceDynamic: Prophetess Miriam, Nells Princess, and Samba Train will ensure a strong gallop from the outset, with all three confirmed front-runners likely to contest the early lead. The extended 2m6½f trip and soft conditions will create a stamina-sapping test, particularly as these pace-setters maintain a solid tempo throughout. Hold-up horses like Eyecanboogie, Mia In Milan, and Lakewood Rose should benefit from the guaranteed strong pace, while several prominent racers possess the tactical speed to capitalize if the pace becomes uneven. This race shape clearly favours hold-up performers and handy prominent types who can finish strongly off a solid gallop.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If all three front-runners maintain their aggressive tactics and create genuine pace pressure
scenarios.body: The extended distance and good-to-soft conditions will find out the pace-setters in the final half-mile, setting up perfectly for hold-up horses to sweep past tired leaders. Fresh closers with stamina will have ideal conditions to unleash finishing kicks.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Tactical Front-Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Samba Train uses her proven 2-mile winning ability to dictate terms and kick clear
scenarios.body: Her superior class rating and strong course form gives her the tactical edge to control the tempo and outbattle rivals when it matters. The prominent racers will struggle to match her acceleration from a position of strength.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the genuine pace collapses early and allows a handy prominent type to seize control
scenarios.body: Horses like Poetic Twist and Miss Jocund can exploit any lull in tempo by moving closer to the pace and timing their challenges perfectly. Their tactical positioning gives them first run on tiring leaders while avoiding the traffic issues that affect hold-up horses.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Emerges Late
scenarios.trigger: If the combination of strong pace and testing conditions creates a blanket finish with stamina paramount
scenarios.body: The extended trip becomes the key factor as several unfancied but proven stayers find extra reserves in the final furlong. Horses with question marks over shorter trips suddenly find their ideal conditions.

races.paceDynamic: Tomthescaffolder is the sole confirmed front-runner and will set his own tempo without early pressure from the large field. The prominent brigade of State Pension, Tiger Twins, Danalii, Splendid Fellow, Lemmy Caution and Lucky Vick will track behind but none are aggressive early types. This creates a moderate gallop that will quicken from 3f out when the prominent horses engage, before the hold-up merchants including Happy Me, Ask The Bookie and Glenroyal launch their challenges. This pace shape clearly favours prominent racers who can position handily and have first run on the leaders before the closers arrive.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Brigade Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the pace stays steady and prominent horses get first run from 3f out
scenarios.body: The handily-placed runners will have the jump on both the leader and hold-up horses, with enough left to resist late challenges. Quality prominent types with proven stamina will prove too strong.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Heroes Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the pace quickens significantly from halfway as prominent horses engage early
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will set up perfectly for the patient closers who time their runs to perfection. Glenroyal's class and Happy Me's finishing kick become decisive weapons.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lonely Leader Lasts
scenarios.trigger: If Tomthescaffolder gets an easy lead and the field fails to organize a proper challenge
scenarios.body: The front-runner will have enough left in reserve to resist the late surge, particularly on this stamina-testing trip. His uncontested advantage proves insurmountable in a race lacking genuine pace pressure.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos In Large Field
scenarios.trigger: If the large field causes interference or bunching problems at crucial stages
scenarios.body: Race positioning becomes paramount and those drawn well or with tactical speed benefit from others' misfortune. The race falls apart tactically, favoring horses that avoid trouble.

races.paceDynamic: My Gaffer is the sole confirmed front runner and will set uncontested fractions early with no pace pressure. Six horses (Duty Bound, Falco Blitz, Elusive Ogie, Burru, Therellbguddaysyet, William Tell) all want prominent positions behind My Gaffer, creating inevitable traffic problems and scrimmaging from 2-3 out as they jostle for racing room. The large hold-up contingent (Watch The Weather, Fiveonefive, Themanintheanorak, Redwood Queen, King In Love, Lord Ffrench, Maxios Prime, Royal Soldier) will be relying on the pace collapse, but with only My Gaffer up front, the tempo may not be strong enough to set it up. This race shape clearly favours the lone leader My Gaffer and those prominent runners who can secure clean positions early before the midrace congestion hits.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Uncontested Leader Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If My Gaffer gets easy fractions with no pace pressure from the field.
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace allows My Gaffer to dictate throughout and kick clear when the prominent pack behind him gets tangled up from 3 out. His recent win at this track gives him the perfect profile for this scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Traffic Carnage
scenarios.trigger: If the six prominent runners create significant interference fighting for position from 2-3 out.
scenarios.body: The scrimmaging allows a clean-travelling hold-up horse to sweep through on the outside while the prominent pack compromises each other. Watch The Weather with Jack Kennedy can pick his way through the chaos.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Early Prominent Gets Clear
scenarios.trigger: If one of the prominent runners (William Tell or Duty Bound) can secure an uncontested second position.
scenarios.body: They can track My Gaffer without getting caught in traffic, then challenge approaching the last when the leader's lack of pace pressure starts to tell. William Tell's dual wins at this distance give him the edge in this scenario.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If My Gaffer sets steady fractions that play into the hands of the hold-up brigade.
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace means the hold-up horses can get competitive positions earlier than usual, with the strongest stayer prevailing up the hill. This scenario needs everything to fall perfectly for the backmarkers.

races.paceDynamic: Butty O Brien and Brave Endeavour will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with Butty O Brien likely to dominate early given his superior form. The pace should be honest but not excessive with 18 runners spreading the field, though Brave Endeavour's tendency to fade in the finish means the tempo may not be sustained throughout. Rusheen, Ballybrittas, Sophia Rose and the prominent runners will track the leaders in the first half, setting up a tactical battle from three furlongs out. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can finish from off the pace, as the early gallop will stretch the field and create opportunities for closers like Iamagetaway, Thegraveyardbookie and Toon Town.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace proves honest and the field spreads out as expected
scenarios.body: The sustained gallop will tire the prominent runners and create perfect conditions for the patient tactics of Iamagetaway and Toon Town to prove decisive. scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Sophia Rose or Rusheen can secure the ideal stalking position behind the pace-setters
scenarios.body: The tactical speed and class of these mid-pack runners allows them to strike at the optimum moment when the leaders weaken but before the hold-up horses can organize their challenge. Sophia Rose's recent form and Rusheen's proven ability at the level make them prime beneficiaries.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Butty O Brien can dictate a more conservative pace than expected given his recent winning form
scenarios.body: His superior fitness and tactical speed from the front allows him to kick clear when the field bunches, exploiting his proven stamina to hold off late challengers. The 10-year-old's experience and Patrick Magee's patient training approach could deliver a front-running success.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If both pace-setters fade dramatically leaving a stop-start tempo throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine early pace creates a messy tactical affair where any horse with a turn of foot can capitalize regardless of usual running style. This scrambled scenario particularly suits horses returning from breaks or those with question marks who can improve significantly for the run.

races.paceDynamic: What Path will lead from the start with no other confirmed front runners, setting a sustainable tempo in this 2m7f test. Journey With Me, Jetoile, Lifetime Ambition and Solitary Man will track prominently behind the leader, creating a steady gallop rather than fierce early pace pressure. The lack of pace pressure early should favor the prominent runners who can position handily and have the class to strike, while the numerous hold-up horses may struggle if the pace becomes too sedate. This race shape clearly favors prominent runners who can sit close to the pace and have the tactical speed to respond.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If What Path sets a steady tempo without fierce pressure from the prominent brigade
scenarios.body: The class horses tracking in second-fourth (Journey With Me, Lifetime Ambition, Jetoile) get the perfect setup to unleash superior speed in the closing stages. The hold-up brigade arrives too late against horses already in striking position with race fitness and tactical advantage.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes too sedate and the prominent runners don't quicken decisively
scenarios.body: The patient tactics of Tullybeg or Gin Coco pay dividends as they sweep past tiring leaders with a sustained late charge. Fresh legs triumph over horses caught too close to pedestrian fractions.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: What Path Wire-To-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If What Path gets easy lead fractions and the prominent runners fail to apply sufficient pressure
scenarios.body: The front runner maintains a soft lead throughout and finds enough in reserve to repel late challenges. Recent form suggests What Path has the stamina to sustain the tempo over this extended trip.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If What Path sets overly slow fractions and the class horses underperform tactically
scenarios.body: A hold-up horse with decent form like Bartlemy Boy or an improving type capitalizes on the tactical muddle. Positioning becomes less important than who has the most energy for the closing stages.

watchPoints.text: What Path could steal this if allowed to dictate soft fractions without early pressure from the prominent brigade
Journey With Me's class advantage may prove decisive if positioned close enough to the pace throughout
Tullybeg represents the main hold-up threat if the pace becomes too steady and lacks genuine speed
Amateur jockeys on several fancied runners could lead to tactical errors in running
Long-absent horses Headcorn and Gin Coco are best watched for market moves indicating fitness
